sanskrit: stuvānam agna ā naya yātudhānaṃ kimīdinam | tvaṃ hi devāntito hantā dasyor babhūvitha ||
english: O Agni, bring hither the yātudhāna who is chanting praise, the kimīdin — for thou hast indeed become the slayer of the dasyu, most favored of the gods.

sanskrit: ājyasya parameṣṭhiñ jātavedas tanūvaśin | agne taulasya prāśāna yātudhānān vi lāpaya ||
english: O Parameṣṭhin of the oblation, O Jātavedas, O master of thy body — O Agni, having partaken of the tula-offering, cause the yātudhānas to cry out in distress.

sanskrit: vi lapantu yātudhānā atriṇo ye kimīdinaḥ | athedam agne no havir indraś ca prati haryatam ||
english: Let the yātudhānas wail — those ravenous devourers who are kimīdins — and do thou, O Agni, and Indra, find delight in this our oblation.

sanskrit: agniḥ purastād ā yacchatu prendro nudatu bāhumān | bravītu sarvo yātumān ayam asmīty etya ||
english: Let Agni seize him from the front; let the mighty-armed Indra drive him on — let every sorcerer come forward declaring, 'Here I am!'

sanskrit: paśyāmi te vīryā jātavedaḥ pra ṇo brūhi yātudhānān nṛcakṣaḥ | tvayā sarve paritaptāḥ purastād ā yantu prabruvāṇā upedam ||
english: I behold thy powers, O Jātavedas; declare to us the yātudhānas, O thou who seest men. Scorched by thee on every side, let them come forward openly proclaiming themselves — hither to this place.

sanskrit: ā rabhasva jātavedo hṛdaḥ kāmāya randhaya | dūto no agna ut tiṣṭha yātudhānān ihā naya ||
english: Seize them, O Jātavedas; subdue them for the desire of the heart. Arise as our messenger, O Agni; bring the yātudhānas hither.

sanskrit: tvam agne yātudhānān upabaddhān ihā naya | athaiṣām indro vajreṇa- -api śīrṣāṇi vṛścatu ||
english: Do thou, O Agni, bring the yātudhānas here in bonds — then let Indra with his vajra split open their skulls.

sanskrit: idaṃ havir yātudhānān nadī phenam ivā vahāt | yadīdaṃ strī pumān akar iha sa stuvatāṃ janaḥ ||
english: May this oblation carry away the yātudhānas as a river carries foam. Whoever — whether woman or man — has done this deed, let that person come hither and give praise.

sanskrit: yātudhānasya somapa jahi prajāṃ nayasva ca | ni ṣṭuvānasya pātaya param akṣy utāvaram ||
english: O Soma-drinker, strike down the offspring of the yātudhāna and lead them away; of the one who is chanting, strike out the upper eye and also the lower.

sanskrit: ayaṃ stuvāna āgamat taṃ smota prati haryata | bṛhaspate vaśe kṛthā agnīṣomā vi vidhyatam ||
english: This chanting one has come — recognize him, take pleasure in seizing him. O Bṛhaspati, bring him under control; O Agni and Soma, pierce him through.

sanskrit: yāṃ tvā gandharvo akhanad varuṇāya mṛtabhraje | tāṃ tvā vayaṃ khanāmasy oṣadhiṃ śepaharṣaṇīm ||
english: Thee whom the Gandharva dug up for Varuṇa, for the nurturing of the dead — thee, that herb which arouses the phallus, we now dig up.

sanskrit: vṛṣaṇas te khanitāro vṛṣā tvam asy oṣadhe | vṛṣāsi vṛṣṇyāvatī vṛṣaṇe tvā khanāmasi ||
english: Bulls are thy diggers; a bull art thou, O herb. Thou art virile, endowed with virility — for the sake of the virile one we dig thee up.

sanskrit: ud uṣā ud u sūrya uc chuṣmā oṣadhīnām | ud ejati prajāpatir vṛṣā śuṣmeṇa vājinā ||
english: Up rises the Dawn, up rises the Sun, up rises the vigorous power of the herbs — Prajāpati, the bull, stirs with potent, prize-winning force.

sanskrit: ūrdhvaśrāṇam idaṃ kṛdhi yathā sma te virohato abhitaptam ivānati | tatas te śuṣmavattaram iyaṃ kṛṇotv oṣadhiḥ ||
english: Make this one erect upward — just as when two growing shoots bend low as if scorched by heat — let this herb make thee more vigorous than that.

sanskrit: apāṃ rasa oṣadhīnām atho vanaspatīnām | atho somasya bhrātāsy ārśyam asi vṛṣṇyam ||
english: Thou art the sap of the waters, of the herbs, and of the forest trees; thou art moreover the brother of Soma — thou art the virile power belonging to the ṛṣi's lineage.

sanskrit: aśvasya ṛśyasya bastasya puruṣasya ca | ya ṛṣabhasya vājas tam asmai dhehy oṣadhe ||
english: The vigour of the horse, of the spotted deer, of the he-goat, and of the man — even the prize-winning force of the bull — bestow that upon him, O herb.

sanskrit: saṃ vājā ṛṣabhāṇāṃ saṃ śuṣmā oṣadhīnām | saṃ puṃsām indra vṛṣṇyam asmai dhehi tanūbalam ||
english: Gather together the prize-forces of the bulls, gather the vigors of the herbs — gather the virility of males, O Indra; bestow upon him bodily strength.

sanskrit: adyāgne adya savitar adya devi sarasvati | adyā me brahmaṇaspate dhanur ivā tānayā pasaḥ ||
english: Today, O Agni; today, O Savitṛ; today, O divine Sarasvatī; today, O Brahmaṇaspati — stretch my membrum like a bowstring.

sanskrit: ūrdhvās tiṣṭhanti giraya ūrdhvā vātā ud īrate | ūrdhvo 'yaṃ māmako mayūkha ivādhi bhūmyām ||
english: Upright stand the mountains; upward the winds blow; upright shall this one of mine stand upon the earth like a post.

sanskrit: ut tiṣṭhogra vi dhūnuṣva vi te śvayantu nāḍyaḥ | atandro aśvapā iva nāva glāyo 'dhi muṣkayoḥ ||
english: Rise up, O fierce one; shake thyself; let thy channels swell up. Untired, like a horse-guard keeping watch over a ship, let there be no weakness upon the testicles.

sanskrit: hiraṇyaśṛṅgo vṛṣabho yaḥ samudrād udācarat | tenā sahasyenā vayaṃ ni janānt svāpayāmasi ||
english: The golden-horned bull who arose from the ocean — with him, with that mighty one, we lull all these people to sleep.

sanskrit: na bhūmiṃ vāto 'ti vāti nāti tapati sūryaḥ | janāṃś ca sarvān svāpaya śunaś cendrasakhā caran ||
english: The wind does not blow past the earth; the sun does not scorch beyond it — lull to sleep all the people and the dogs as well, O friend of Indra, as thou movest about.

sanskrit: vahyeśayāḥ proṣṭheśayā nārīr yās talpaśīvarīḥ | striyo yāḥ puṇyagandhās tāḥ sarvāḥ svāpayāmasi ||
english: The women who sleep in carriages, who sleep on couches, those who lie on beds — the women who are of fragrant perfume — all of them we lull to sleep.

sanskrit: ejadejad ajagrabhaṃ cakṣuḥ prāṇam ajagrabham | aṅgāny agrabhaṃ sarvā rātrīṇām atiśarvare ||
english: Quivering and quivering, I have seized the sight; I have seized the breath. I have seized all the limbs in the deepest darkness of the nights.

sanskrit: ya āste yaś ca carati yaś ca tiṣṭhan vipaśyati | teṣāṃ saṃ dadhmo akṣāṇi yathedaṃ harmyaṃ tathā ||
english: He who sits, and he who moves about, and he who stands gazing about — we close the eyes of all of them, just as this house is closed.

sanskrit: svaptu mātā svaptu pitā svaptu śvā svaptu viśpatiḥ | svapantu sarve jñātayaḥ sarvaṃ ni ṣvāpayā janam ||
english: Let the mother sleep; let the father sleep; let the dog sleep; let the lord of the house sleep — let all the kinsmen sleep; lull all the people to sleep.

sanskrit: svapna svapnābhikaraṇena sarvaṃ ni ṣvāpayā janam | otsūryam anyān svāpaya- -āvyuṣaṃ caratād aham indra ivāriṣṭo akṣitaḥ ||
english: O Sleep, with thy sleep-inducing power lull all the people to sleep. Put the others to sleep until after sunrise — let me move about till dawn, unharmed and uninjured, like Indra.
